name: Euler Ancestral CFG++
plain: The CFG++ version of ancestral Euler: renoising follows the unconditional prediction and fresh noise is added afterward. It handles flow and non-flow models in one formula, through α factors rather than a separate RF branch. The cfg=1 shortcut is off so both passes always run.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
α_s=σ·e^{λ(σ)}, α_t=σ'·e^{λ(σ')}; d_u=(x−α_s·U)/σ.
σ_down,σ_up=get_ancestral_step(σ/α_s, σ'/α_t, η); σ_down←α_t·σ_down.
x'=α_t·D+σ_down·d_u; if η>0 and s_noise>0: x'+=α_t·n·s_noise·σ_up. s_noise multiplied by noise_scale.

props.prediction_space: half-logSNR scaling factors; eps taken from U
props.flow_const: Unified through α factors, no RF dispatch and no first-sigma offset. On σ=1, α_s=0 so σ/α_s is inf; reading get_ancestral_step, that yields σ_up=σ'/α_t and σ_down=0 (inference, not run).
